title: cocode.changed (event)
description: The text settled: 500 ms after the last keystroke, settled text only. Sent when the human typed, pasted, accepted a ghost or undid, and when a Claude command or a restore changed the text. Predict the next lines with cocode.suggest, but only for by "human".

truncated.description: true when text was longer than 64 000 characters; the tail is kept.

detected.description: false when the human or Claude set the language chip.

selection.description: The selected range, or null (or absent) when nothing is selected.

lines.description: Number of lines in text. An empty editor has 1.

prefix.description: The caret line's text up to the caret (at most 200 characters).

by.description: Who changed the text. Stay silent on claude and restore.

delta.description: The changed line range when known.

text.description: The text of that line range.

rev.description: Document revision; starts at 1 and never goes down.

lang.description: Free text, 1-24 characters: python, js, my-lang, pseudo.

col.description: 0-based column, in characters of the line.
